# VIX over 30 in the early session, Nov 24, carded about 14 hours late

| Reading (vendor 1-minute ^VIX, not Cboe) | Value |

| First print over 30 | 08:13 ET (after a flat 32.38 from 08:08 to 08:12) |
| Continuous prints over 30 | 08:15 to 08:20 ET, high 30.40 at 08:18; again 30.04 at 08:35 |
| 32.38, five identical one-minute bars, 08:08 to 08:12 ET | jumped from 28.91 to 32.38 in one bar and fell back; reads as a bad tick. **The +5 leg (31.62, from the 26.62 close) is met only on that print: UNCONFIRMED** |
| Regular session (from 09:30 ET) high | 29.57: under 30 |
| Close | 26.36 (11/23 26.62, 11/20 35.89) |

- **Why FLASH, late:** FILTER_SPEC's pre-gate bypass fires on the safety net even when late or a duplicate; the row does not exclude the early session. Every action below is stale: check your own line at Cboe.

- **Cause of the 08:08 to 08:20 move: not established.** Car-Mart's filing was accepted 08:23 ET, after it. AMD had fallen after its resale registration on 11/23 evening.
- HY for 11/23: 363 bp (SIG-W-20261124-002).

title: REG-T-04 fires on its letter: HY OAS 363 bp [Nov 23], the third consecutive close over 350 (352, 376, 363, FRED first-published); REGINALD to run its WQ-512 single-issuer rider; HY narrowed 13 bp on the day
body:
# REG-T-04 (HY OAS over 350, three consecutive closes): FIRED on the letter

| Observation | HY OAS, bp (FRED first-published) | Over 350? |
|---|---|---|
| 11/18 | 347 | no |
| 11/19 | 352 | 1 of 3 |

- CCC 1,387 [11/23] from 1,402; BB 219 from 229. HY fell 13 bp on the third close: the rule counts level, not direction. Nov 24 is not a published cell yet; the fire needs no more data.
- **REGINALD's own rider (WQ-512, disclosure, not a gate):** before the consequence runs, state each named single-issuer restructuring's contribution and the level without it; if that level is 350 or lower, the Will-facing text must say the fire rests on the named issuers. Car-Mart filed Chapter 11 the next day (SIG-W-20261124-003); whether its bonds are in the index is REGINALD's check.
- **Cross-check owed by REGINALD's letter:** run the bank-credit cross-check before reading HY as bank transmission. KRE closed 69.54 [11/23] and 69.76 [11/24], rising.
- **Chain per the registry:** REGINALD ACTION, LIQUID ACTION, Will. Action token ISSUANCE-FREEZE. Exit: 330 or lower on five consecutive closes.
- REG-T-03 (over 320) stays fired; RED-FT-02's exit count is RED's. The safety net on a +25 bp single session is not met.
- **Reported late:** the cell was published on 11/23 and the fleet was offline; WALTER first read it 11/24 22:27 ET.

title: America's Car-Mart filed prepackaged Chapter 11 Tue Nov 24 (8-K read at SEC): stalking-horse sale to Cardinal, $311.6M prepetition debt accelerated, $60M new DIP money plus up to $65M roll-up, trade to be paid in full, ACMAT securitization trusts are not debtors
body:
# America's Car-Mart (CRMT): Chapter 11, read at the primary

8-K accepted 2026-11-24 08:23 ET (Items 1.01, 1.03, 2.04, 5.02, 7.01, 8.01); exhibit 99.1 read. The fourteenth lender standstill ran out Sun 11/22 with nothing filed (BROCK 11/23 12:09 ET; WALTER saw no filing 11/23).

| Object | What the filing says |
|---|---|
| Court and form | voluntary Chapter 11, US Bankruptcy Court, Southern District of Texas; proposed prepackaged plan; debtors in possession |
| Buyer | 'stalking horse' APA 11/24 with Claypool Holdings, Cardinal Finance, ACM-AR, ACM Finance, Cardinal Asset Holdings ('Cardinal Holdings'; leadership includes a former Car-Mart CEO and chairman) for substantially all assets, including the residual certificates and 100% of ACM Funding, LLC |
| Consideration | cash: $10.0M + $13.6M owned real property + retail inventory at Black Book wholesale + $10.0M new inventory; **rollover debt on terms to be agreed**; assumed liabilities including securitization liabilities, cure costs, vehicle service contracts |
| Debt | Prepetition Credit Agreement (10/30/2025) **$311.6M principal, accelerated automatically, stayed** (Item 2.04) |
| DIP | up to **$60M new money** ($35M interim, $25M final) + **up to $65M roll-up** of prepetition debt; SOFR + 10.50%; matures 5/22/2027; same lenders as prepetition |
| Recovery | trade paid in full; general unsecured proposed in full; equity $2.5M from excluded assets plus residual, **'no assurance'**; company warns of 'a significant or complete loss' for stock |
| Milestones | bidding procedures order within 21 days, sale order within 35 days of 11/24; rollover documents agreed by 12/3/2026; closing outside date 2/21/2027; break-up fee $9.0M; HSR needed |
| Securitizations | the ACMAT trusts **are not debtors**; notes payable only from trust assets, not guaranteed; company asks to keep servicing |
| People | CEO Campbell $2.0M, CFO and COO $0.5M each, paid from sale proceeds, $5.6M cap (Item 5.02 is compensation, not departures) |

- **Not in the text:** lender names beyond the agreement, the size of the ABS notes outstanding, dealer-level collections, any bank's exposure. The ABS read, advance rates and servicer-default triggers are OTTO's and BROCK's.
- **BRK-33 (petition by 12/31, 35%, per BROCK's row):** event occurred on WALTER's read; BROCK grades. Prior WALTER note: lender-side disclosures on the 10/30 agreement.
- **Caution:** Item 5.02 in the 8-K header is bonuses, not a departure; do not relay it as an officer exit.
